worldcombat.skill.victorydance.summary: A rite that calls victory: the user salutes, stamps each beat really into the ground and closes a laurel crown of clear crown lines on the last one, boosting Attack, Defence and Speed. The crown lasts for a visible window, but each landed active attack while it is up extends it; the moment the dance finishes an absolute latest end is recorded, so no density of hits can keep it past that point. When it finally ends, the three stats it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.use.0: Raise Attack, Defence and Speed before the fight is decided
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.use.1: Hold the rite while the foe is low and let hits keep the victory alive
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.use.2: Plant your feet and show your colours with the grandest dance
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.descripti: After the wind-up Attack, Defence and Speed each rise by %1$s.
The crown lasts %1$s; when it ends those three stats are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.rally: While the crown lasts, each time the dancer lands an active attack on an enemy the window extends by %1$s, up to the absolute latest end recorded when the dance finished (%2$s); one attack that strikes several targets counts once, and residual damage such as poison or a field never extends it. Past that point it never grows again and the crown must fall.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.grand.on: Grand: the crown window multiplied by 1.4, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up and 20 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.grand.off: Plain: the regular window, quicker to finish.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.growth.0: At level %1$s the crown window stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.growth.1: At level %1$s the crown window stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.preferenc: On: the crown window multiplied by 1.4, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up and 20 ticks more cooldown. Off: plain, quicker to finish.
The rite is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means raising the crown earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of dancing; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
